tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gdugs dkar gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyi cho ga bzhugs so//

de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dge rnams// de bzhin gshegs par mdzad pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas// de bzhin gshegs ma byon der 'dud// gang gi rig rgyal cho ga yis// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// mi mthun phyogs rnams phyir bzlog pas// dad ldan ched du de rtsom bya// bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyi mi thub ma bsgrub par 'dod pas/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las lar sbyor ba'i tshul shes par bya'o// de la dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi dbang ngam rjes su gnang ba thob dam tshig dang ldan pas/ gnas dben zhing yid mthun par bris sam 'bur du dod pa'i sku mchod pa bzang pos mdun bdar ba/ de'i mdun na rang nyid khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ smyung bar gnas pas sam/ gzhan du mngar gsum dang dkar gsum gyi kha zas las gzhan spangs/ stan bde ba la gnas par bya'o// dus 'di nas gzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ phyog bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog/ ces lan gsum bya/ de nas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i sku las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/

phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa cis kyang mi tshugs cis kyang mi shigs cis kyang mi 'jig pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung por 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa de las phyag rgya'i tshogs bcu 'phros te steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi bgegs bsrung ba'i phyir bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ṛ ṣi ga ṇa zhes nas rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ bsrung du gsol lo// zhes pa'i bar gyi sngags bzla/ de nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ spyan drangs/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā rā pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa zhabs bsil/ puṣ+pe ma le swā hā sa me tog gi gdan phul/ bcom ldan shākya seng ge yi// dbu yi gtsug tor nas byung ba// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mchog mnga' ba'i// gdugs dkar 'khor dang bcas la bstod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta/ dngos dang sngags rgya yid kyis sprul pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum/ badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dha rmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o// de las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba'i don byas te/

tshur 'dus pa las gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur te/ de las 'od zer lha mo'i sku dang bcas pa spros pas 'jig rten thams cad du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bkrol te/ tshur 'dus pas/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can/ sku mdog dkar mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi gdugs dkar po 'dzin pa/ sprul pa'i dbu stong phyag stong mnga' ba la/ spyan bye ba brgya phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu la mi phyed rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad pa/ bdag dang gzhan rnams 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis kun nas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis ma/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la oṃ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag bskyed gtso 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa'i tshogs rnams byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ lag pa snyim pa sbyar bskyod cing*/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ bdag gi smon lam dang bsod nams kyi stobs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad mchod pa'i sprin chen pos thams cad gang bar gyur cig de nas mdun gyi sku gzugs sam dkyil 'khor ram rten ci yod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang*/

ba gaṃ 'dzam bu na dī ha rā nag po'i steng gi gser gdung las mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rgya phubs kyi lcam sna las thur du in+d+ra nī la'i shar bu dang*/ pad kyi thad dang mnyam pa'i steng du karke ta'i mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang gdugs ba dan rnam pa mang pos mdzes pa/ thog 'phar ma gsum brtsegs kyi dbus 'phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan cing*/ sgo bzhi'i sgo khyud twa ra ṇa bzhis spras pa'i rtser/ gdugs kyis phub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ pad+ma la gnas pa la ri dwags zung mig mi 'dzum par blta ba/ 'bar ba/ bkra ba blta na sdug pa/ rnam par phye ba/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal zhing nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba rgya dang khyon blos mi 'khyud pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa// de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa lte bar seng ge'i gdan de'i steng du nyi zla/ lha gnas rnams su nyi zla'i gdan re 'khod par gyur/ de nas dri zhim po'i spos dang*/ rol mo dbyangs snyan pos/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor gyi// zhing khams bsam mi khyab pa nas// bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo// gzhan gyis mi thub lha mo che// phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*// sprul pa bka' nyan thams cad kyis// mdun bdar mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon// badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā ra mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes bzhugs pa'i mchod yon phul bas gzhal yas khang nang du byon te/ dbus kyi gdan bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo nas skyob pa zhes pa'i bar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dbu'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa/ pad 'dab la g.yas skor gyis lha mo drag shul chen mo dang*/ rab gtum ma dang*/ 'bar ma chen mo dang*/

stobs chen ma dang*/ phyogs kyi mdog can/ rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten cing bum pa thugs kar bzung bas 'gying ba phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba gos dkar mo ser mo/ 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can sngo bsangs/ rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng zhes grags pa ljang khu/ g.yas 'phreng ba/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ lho'i rtsibs la/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma 'phreng ba can da kar mo/ g.yas rdo rje/ rdo rje mkhar rnams 'joms pa mo ser mo/ g.yas dbyug pa/ zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma nag mo/ g.yas spos phor/ gzugs zhi gzi brjid can ser mo/ g.yas rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ g.yon thams cad rin po che bsnams pa/ nub kyi rtsibs la/ 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen ma dmar mo/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan ma ser mo/ rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma dkar mo/ lag na rdo rje rig 'dzin ma ljang khu/ bzhi ka g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ byang gi rtsibs bzhi la le brgan rtsi rin chen ma dmar mo/ snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags dkar mo/ rnam par 'gying ba'i rdo rje ma ljang khu/ gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma ser mo/ bzhi ka g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ steng du rdo rje sgrol dkar mo/ 'og tu pad+ma'i spyan zla 'od gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lha mo de thams cad cung zad khros pa/ lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang na bza' can sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'o// grwa bzhir/ me tog ma dang bdug spos ma// mar me ma dang dri chab ma// dkar sngo dmar ljang ba rang ming gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub tu lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo/ byang du dril bu ma ljang khu 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad phyi rol kyi khor yug la kun nas bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//

nas/ gsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar phyag bya/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ sarba trā sam ku su ma ti/ a dhi dz+nyā ra shi ra nī/ na mo stu te swā hā/ gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ yon tan bsngags pa rgya mtsho sgrogs pa'i dbyangs rab 'byams sems can gyi khams thams cad dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su grags pa 'jug pa gyur cig srid gsum ston pa mi dang lha yi lha// mtshungs med bde gshegs shākya seng ge yi// mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyil ba'i spyi gtsug nas// ya mtshan rmad byung lha mo khro rgyal gtso// khams gsum dag na khyed 'dra'i mgon med de// thugs rje'i dbang phyug bkra shis mchog gi lha// sku mdog gangs ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra// zhal mang stong la spyan mang bye ba brgya// srid pa'i btson rar sems can nyams thag pa// dus gsum gzigs nas sems can grol mdzad de// zhal stong phyag stong spyan stong rnams kyis ni// kun la khyab mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ma rig nongs pas bslus pa'i sems can rnams// rang gi las nyid rnam par smin pa yi// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i rims nad mi bzad pa// zhi mdzad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji ltar khyod kyis sems can mang po la// thugs rje mchog gis 'gro don nyer gzung nas// srid gsum 'jigs pa che las bsgral gyur cing*// sdug bsngal mang po'i nad las thar mdzad ltar// bdag kyang khyod bzhin 'gro ba'i mgon gyur te// sems can klu yi zhags pas zin pa dang*// nad kyi bskal pas nyen pa'i sems can la// sdug bsngal sel ba'i skyabs su bdag gyur cig /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /nas/ pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*// phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod// mchod pa ni/ lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// mtshar sdug lang tshos snyems pa'i gar// me tog 'phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris mdun sa bzhin du mchod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

lha mo gnam kha ltar mthing gzugs// dri zhi ngad pa 'thul ba'i gar// bdug spos 'phreng bas/ mtho ris/ dhū pe/ lha mo mtshams sprin ltar dmar gzugs// nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od 'phro'i gar// mar me'i 'phreng bas/ mtho ris/ ā lo ke lha mo mar gad ltar ljang gzugs// reg pas sim byed byug pa'i gar// dri chab 'phreng bas/ mtho ris/ gan+dhe/ lha mo gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs// ma mchu'i ro brgyas mngar ba'i gar// zhal zas 'phreng bas/ mtho ris/ nai wi d+ya/ lha mo baiḍūr+ya ltar sngo gzugs// snyan 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i gar// rol mo'i 'phreng bas/ mtho ris/ shap+ta/ rgyas par/ 'dzam bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ sitā ta pa tra sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ thal dkar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen/ ha sti rat+na/ spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnam bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen/ a shwa rat+na/ kun tu sngo ba snang byed baiḍūr+ya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen/ ma ṇi rat+na/ 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg pa mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang gter// btsun mo rin chen/ s+t+rī rat+na/ phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhungs pa/ khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can/ khyim bdag rin chen/ pu ru ṣa rat+na/ sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la brgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen

khaḍ+ga rat+na/ 'od zer gyi sngo ral gri pags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro/ mthu ldan mchil lham khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzims cha/ u pa rat+na/ pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas snyems pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /shrī bat+s+ya/ 'jigs byed kun da'i 'od ldan lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /su warna tsakra/ 'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /pad+ma kuñtsa ra/ rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma// rgyal mtshan bsgreng zhing ga ma kas bcings glus// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /kun+da dh+wa dza/ mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /si tā ta pa tra/ dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtsed 'jo yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /nidhi gha ṭa/ dri med mar gad mdangs can dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnams 'jo sgeg gis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /shaṅkha warta/ yid gzhungs rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' bskyed ma// gser gyi nya 'dzin 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig
/ka na ka mat+s+ya/

zhes mchod nas/ thugs ka gnyis su oṃ la sngags kyi 'phreng ba mu tig gi 'phreng ba lta bus bskor bar dmigs nas zhal dang lte bar mgal me ltar 'khor bas rang gzhan thams cad kyi nad gdon la sogs pa bsregs par bsams nas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shad de bi shad de/ bai re bai re/ badz+ra dha ri/ ban dha ban dha ṇi/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭ/ hūm̐ pā ṇi phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ hūm̐ drūm̐ ban dha phaṭ swā hā/ 'bum la sogs pa bzlas par bya'o// de nas ngal lam/ gtong bar 'dod na/ bzlas pa yid kyis 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo la phul te/ bdag las kyi lha mos 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya ste/ bzod par gsol zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos nas gshegs su gsol// de nas lus bsrung bar bya ste ldang bar bya'o// langs nas kyang mdo sde zab mo bklag pa la sogs pa bya'o// rtag tu 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo dran par bya'o// phyag 'tshal bar dmigs shing 'byung po'i kha zas spangs te bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi gzung*// gnyis pa la ni sta gon bya// nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis// zhes pa'i dang po ni/ dpon slob kyi 'brel legs par shes nas/ rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i phyir sa'i dbus su dri'i thig le bya/ me tog gi tshom bu dgram/ mchod gtor bshams la/ gtsang sbra bya ba nas bzlas pa'i bar du byas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje brdabs pas/ sa'i dbus su sa'i lha mo bstan ma mdzes sdug mtshungs pa med pa rgyan gyis brgyan te 'khor 'bum phrag dang bcas pa lus phyed snang bar 'thon pa la/

pra ti bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pra ti bh+yaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba li ta swā hā/ gang yang sa la gnas pa dang*// sa la rgyu ba'i lha klu rnams// mchod dang gtor ma 'di long la// sems can kun dge don du yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod// ces bslangs pas phyogs 'dir ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba sbyin te gzhi'i bdag po dang bcas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur/ yid ches pa'i sa min na ro lnga bsal/ rin po che lnga la sogs pa bcug nas 'thas par bcags nas stegs bu gru bzhi pa steng me long gi ngos 'dra ba bya'o// der ba byung ngaṃ dri'i byug pa byugs me tog gsil ma bkram/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ sku gzugs bzhag pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs kyis gzung ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de nas gzung sa der/ skyabs su 'gro ba nas rnam snang gis rgyas gdab pa'i bar byas sta gon gyi bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga bya ste/ ma dang ṭa las mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khro bo'i skur gyur/ slob mas 'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor che// bdag la legs par bshad du gsol// dbang ldan nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha bltas nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ 'gro ba 'dzin pa yis ni byas zin gyis// hūm̐ hūm̐ gdug pa'i yid can gang yin pha tshad song*// hūm̐ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po sdang mig 'bar ba yis// hūm̐ hūm̐ thal ba bzhin du byas ta re// shar phyogs nas ni char chen 'bebs// me phyogs glo bur snang ba byung*// gshin rje 'chi bdag gzugs su byung*// bden bral sems can la 'jigs byed// chu phyogs gshin rje 'brug sgra sgrogs// rlung gi phyogs nas 'tshub ma 'byung*// gnod sbyin pho mo byang phyogs nas// dbang ldan phyogs nas sna tshogs gzugs// steng nas mthu chen lha rnams dang*// 'og nas sa 'gas g.yo byed pa// gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// bgegs rnams thams cad 'gro bar gyis//

zhes thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags ring brjod// rdo rje 'gros kyis skor ba lan gsum bya// de nas dbus su 'dug ste/ sku las 'od 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa de las phyag rgya'i tshogs bcu stod khro mo smad phur bu phyogs kyi gdon la btab ste bzhugs pa/ oṃ ṛ ṣi sogs kyi bsrung sngags bzla/ de nas lha gnas ma 'chol bar/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi/ 'khor gnas su zlum po la me tog gi tshom bu bkod mtha' mchod pas bskor/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ dkyil 'khor oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs pa nas lha gnas rnams su nyi zla'i gdan re 'khod par gyur gyi bar brjod/ dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'gro ba'i don byas te tshur 'dus pa las/ gdugs dkar mo zhes pa nas/ 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ pad 'dab la g.yas skor gyis/ lha mo drag shul chen mo nas/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad phyi rol gyi khor yug la kun nas bskor te bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i cha smad la hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la oṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsams la/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang nas aṅku sha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ nas/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ba lha sta gon no// de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga'am gcig mgul dkris/ kha rgyan/ nang rdzas dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bkod/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bh+ruṃ las phyi bum pa bzang po/ nang gzhal yas kyi khang de'i dbus su nas/ lha thams cad gsal btab pa rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/

de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang bstod pa byas/ sngags bzla ba'i dus/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// tshur 'dus bdag gi sdig pa sbyangs nas bum par zhugs te ngo bo chu la rnam pa lha shin tu gsal bar blta'o// de nas 'od du zhu bas ngo bo lha rnam pa chur blta'o// bum pa sta gon no// de nas slob ma khrus byas me tog thogs slob dpon dang lha la phyag 'tshal du bcug nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'das pa dang sogs kyis spro ba bskyed/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni sogs kyis nyan par gdams/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyi skyabs sems sdom pa phog slob ma gdugs dkar du bskyed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ mchod/ so shing gtad/ badz+ra hā sa a/ zhes pas dor du bcug hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥ sogs kyis khyor chu sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ gyis bzlas pas ku sha sngas dang stan du byas/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i srung skud skyed pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon du bcing*/ badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes bsrung*/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams sogs kyis chos bshad / bzhin bzang dag do nub nyol la rmi lam rtog shig dang*/ sang dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod/ slob ma sta gon no// de nas sta gon gyi lha la/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo// rigs pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la brtse don du// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// yo byad ci 'byor gyis bri na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes snyan gsan phab bo// gsum pa ni/

de nas sta gon gyi lha la mchod pa byas te/ badz+ra driṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ ces nam mkha' la bteg la tshon sna lnga'i srad bu gsar pa gtsang ma mdzes pa/ shin tu ran pa/ dri zhim pa/ reg pa bde ba/ legs par bkal ba sbom phra ran pa/ 'jur mdud med pa/ dkar po la raṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin/ dmar po la kaṃ thugs kyi rang bzhin/ ser po la aṃ thub pa byang chub snying po'i rang bzhin/ ljang khu la saṃ phyag na rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ sngon po la hūm̐ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rang bzhin du bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes bzlas la nyer mchod lngas mchod la thig btab de nas rin po che'am/ sā lu'am/ sa'i phye ma rnam lnga la sngar bzhin bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes bzlas mchod nas bri'o// tshar nas tshon skud kyi dra ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla bre logs la lda ldi ral gri mda' bo me long brgyad dar dpyangs lhab lhub la sogs pa/ 'og tu mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bstar bas lha yi rgyal po'i mdun sa lta bur bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ bdag bskyed byas/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa sta gon bzhin du byas nas/ 'jug pa dngos ni/ legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma phul/ bar chad bsrung bar gsol ba gdab/ slob ma khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab/ spro ba bskyed/ nyan par gdams/ sems bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i bar slob ma sta gon bzhin byas la mig dar bcing ngo*// phyi 'jug bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// gtso bo 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// mi shes mun gyis bsgribs pa la// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ lam chen 'di ni bstan par bya// khyod kyis lam 'di sgrub par gyis// lam mchog bsgrub la rab tu dga'// nyes pa dag gis ma gos par// 'bras bu myur du 'byin par byed// dam tshig 'das na dmyal bar ltung*//

slob mas/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor che// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la zhugs pas byin gyis brlab par bsam mo// bsnyen sngags kyi mthar ā be sha ya a a zhes btags pa bzla'o// yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir sogs kyis me tog dor/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis sogs kyis mig dar dbye/ dkyil 'khor rten dang bcas pa khra lam gyi mthong bar mos pa byas la 'jug pa'o// dbang bskur ba ni/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog/ nas/ bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol// des lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma stan gtsang ma'i khar bzhag cho ga gsum gyis gdugs dkar mo can bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa byas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ bum pa bzang po dag byed chus gang ba// glu sgra rol mor ldan pas dbang bskur bas// lus kyi sgrib sbyangs zhe sdang rnam sbyangs pas// me long lta bu'i ye shes rtogs par shog /badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ nub kyi bum pa mgrin par bzhag nas/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ ngag gi sgrib sbyangs 'dod chags rnam dag pas// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog/ ṣiñtsa hrīḥ dbus kyi bum pa snying gar bzhag nas/ yid kyis sgrib sbyangs gti mug rnam dag pas// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rtogs par shog/ ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ lho'i bum pa lte bar bzhag nas/ nyon mongs sgrib sbyangs nga rgyal rnam dag pas// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs par shog ṣiñtsa traṃ/ byang gi bum pa gsang gnas su bzhag nas/

sgo lnga'i sgrib sbyangs phrag dog rnam dag pas// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog/ ṣiñtsa a/ slob dpon gdugs dkar mo can du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mtha'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng chad de zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams gdugs dkar mo can du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa gyis byas/ bsnyen sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byas// me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs spyi mthun bya'o// de nas spyi'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/ de ni sgrub por bya ba'i dbang ngo*// bgegs zhi bar 'dod na/ byab pa dang*/ bkru ba dang bsrung 'khor gdags par bya'o// 'byor pa rgyas par 'dod na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad mdun du bstar te/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis sogs kyis dbang bskur bar bya'o// slob dpon du 'os pa zhig na de seng ge'i khri pad+ma'i snying po can la bzhag steng du gdugs kyis phub/ nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du gser gyi 'khor lo bzhag nas/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten dag ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// dgang gzar blugs gtad de/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa de dag gi /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// gtang rag gi yon phul/ bsgrub pa chen po ni/ ral gri la sogs pa'i rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i cho ga 'dir ma bshad do// gsum pa las la sbyor ba la/ bsrung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ bsreg pa dang*/ 'phang ba dang*/ mnan pa dang drug las/ dang po ni/ rgyas pa zur du bshad pa bzhin nam/ mdor bsdu na/ de la rang ngam gzhan bsrung bar 'dod pas/ dang por gro ga'am ras sam shing shun la/

gur kum gyis rim pa bzhir gnas par bskor te/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bkod pa'i lte ba la bsrung bar bya ba'i ming srung tshig dang bcas pa bris te/ rtsibs brgyad po dag la ni/ oṃ ṛ ga ṇa/ nas/ a stā nāṃ ma hā'i bar du so sor bris/ gnyis pa la ni tad+ya thā/ oṃ/ nas hūm̐ druṃ ban dha'i bar du sde tshan brgyad du dgod par bya'o// rim pa gsum par ni/ zhi bar byed pa'i rig sngags/ tad+ya thā/ hūm̐/ nas ma ma'i bar du dgod par bya'o// rim pa bzhi par ni/ thams cad 'joms pa'i rigs sngags/ oṃ a si tā/ nas/ lārka zhes/ nas/ wa bi nī ye'i bar du bsrung ba'i tshig dang bcas pa dgod par bya'o// de ltar bris pa de bum pa'i maṇ+ḍal steng du bzhag nas/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya ste 'khor lo'i dbus kyi yi ge las 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can 'khor bcas bskyed par byed do// de nas mdun du gzhal yas khang bsams te/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs mchod par bya ste gzungs nas 'byung bas gsol ba btab la/ bzlas pa brgya'am stong ngam ci tsam 'tsham par bya'o// de nas 'khor la yang mchod cing tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye dbang dang legs ldan la sogs pa la gtor ma phul te/ gsol ba btab nas rang ngam gzhan skyes pa'am bud med de phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba byas nas/ yungs kar dang bcas pas lus sam mgul du btags na/ mes mi tshugs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan no// bzlog pa ni/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon du/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ nang du pho brang zlum po sgo gcig pa phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir/ sna tshogs rdo rje rgya graṃ rwa bzhi/ de'i phyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa byas/ mchod pas bskor/

mdun du 'brub khung*/ de'i nang du/ grog mkhar gyi sa/ ba lang gi lci ba dang rkang rjes kyi sa la/ pha rol gyi byad ma mkhan gyi gzugs byas/ de'i snying gar 'khor lo ni/ dur khrod kyi ras la khrag dang dug dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ ke tshe la sogs pa'i khu bas 'khor lo mu khyud gnyis bskor ba bris te/ nang ma'i lte ba la bsgrub bya'i ming bris pa'i mthar che ge mo mā ra ya bhan dha ya nan/ mu khyud dang por/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ/ nas/ hūm̐ drum̐ ban+dha'i bar du bris pa'i mthar che ge mo mā ra ya bhan+dha ya nan/ zhes bri'o// gnyis pa la thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags ming mā ra ya bhan+dha ya nan bcas pa dgod do// de ltar liṅga 'brub khung gi nang du bcug yungs dkar/ ke tshe/ rdo phye/ lcags phye/ zi ra/ bra bo nag po/ sran ma nag po skam thun/ dug chu dang khrag rlon thun/ mchod pa'i gtor ma dang bcas bshams nas/ dang por bdag bskyed ye shes kyi mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas/ de nas las dkyil

bh+ruṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ nas/ de nas de'i nang gi dbus su rin po che'i pho brang zlum po sgo gcig pa/ de'i lte bar gru gsum gyi dbus su seng ge'i gdan/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ phyir sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bzhi/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ dbus kyi seng ge'i gdan la 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can/ dbu stong*/ phyag stong*/ zhabs stong*/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ shar gyi zhal dkar po sgeg pa dang*/ dpa' ba nyis brgya/ lho zhal ser po/ 'jig su rung ba dang rgod pa nyis brgya/ nub kyi zhal dmar po gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa nyis brgya/ byang gi zhal ljang khu/ snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba nyis brgya/ steng gi zhal sngon po/ ngo mtshar ba dang*/ drag po'i nyams can nyis brgya/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba phyag g.yas kyi dang po 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ de 'og dgu bcu rtsa dgus 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ de 'og brgya rdo rje/ de 'og brgya rin po che/ de 'og brgya pad+ma/ de 'og brgya sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon dang po mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og dgu bcu rtsa dgus mda' 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og brgya gzhu/ de 'og brgya ral gri/ de 'og brgya zhabs pa/ de 'og brgya lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas pa lnga brgya brkyang bas rgyal po'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po thams cad gnon par mdzad pa/ g.yon lnga brgya bskum pas mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ dbu re re la khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar bas mtshan pa/ dbu'i steng du gdug bdun dang*/ sangs rgyas bcu la sogs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs bye ba phrag bdun gyi cod pan 'chang ba/ zur gyis blta ba dang*/ bgrod pa dang*/ glog ltar 'gyu ba dang*/ drag tu gzir ba la sogs pa'i spyan dang ldan par/

ba spu'i khung thams cad nas bskal pa'i me 'od 'bar ba/ thugs chos kyi dbyings la dbang bsgyur bas rdo rje yangs ma chen mo/ srid pa gsum la mnga' brnyes pas sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma/ sems can thams cad 'jigs pa ma lus pa las skyabs pa'i bdag nyid can/ zhi khro'i rgyan dang na bzas spras pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las legs ldan nag po mched gsum/ sku mdog mthing nag dar gyi ber chen gsol ba/ phyag g.yas pa tsan dan gyi beng chen bsnams pa/ g.yon pa dgra bgegs kyi snying khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ khro zhing gtum pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ pad+ma la tshangs pa sol ka ba las byed sring mo ming por bcas pa/ rdo rje'i rwa la rgyal po chen po bzhi/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ brgya byin/ me lha/ gshin rje/ srin po/ chu bdag rlung lha/ gnod sbyin/ bgegs chen/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs phyogs kyi bzhi la/ 'byung po dang*/ gza' dang*/ sa bdag dang*/ lha ma yin/ mtshams bzhi la/ mi'am ci dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma/ ma mo dang*/ nam mkha' lding*/ sgo bzhir/ lto 'phye dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ klu dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon de thams cad rang rigs kyi sde dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de nas rang las kyi lha mo'i thugs ka'i oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis gtso 'khor rnams spyan drang bar bya ste/ hūm̐ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas rnams// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// mchod yon zhal bsil bzhes nas kyang*// pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ ga ga na pra wa sat+ka ra pad+ma le sa ma ye s+t+waṃ/ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu// 'byung po gza' gdon sa bdag dang*// lha min mi 'am mkha' 'gro ma// ma tshogs mkha' lding 'dir gshegs shig /lto 'phye che dang rnal 'byor ma// klu yi gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs// spyan 'dren mchod 'bul snyan gsan 'bebs// thugs dam rgyud bskul gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye s+t+waṃ/

zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi dam tshig pa la bstim par bya'o// de nas gtso mo ri khrod ma legs ldan 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rnam pa lnga dang*/ 'dod yon lnga/ lha mo brgyad la sogs pas khyad par mchod la/ rgyud kyi bstod pas bstod par bya'o// de nas thun dang zor rdzas rnams gdug pa can thams cad sgrol ba'i nus ldan du bsams/ thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags bzla zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams na gzhan gyi srog la gnod pa'i dbal mi bzad par gyur pa thams cad de dag la bstim/ phur bu stod lha mo smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'bar ba'i gzugs can du dmigs la mchod bstod/ de nas gser skyems dang*/ gzu dpang brjod/ rang nyid sgrol ging nag po'i ches gcer bu khrag gis byugs pa'am// yang na zhwa dang gos nag gyon rnga dang 'cham stabs su bstun te/ thog mar 'brub khung bskyed pa ni/ 'brub khung 'di nyid bh+ruṃ las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom/ las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang*/ rngams nag pa/ gting ring ba/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu sleb pa/ 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me dpung 'bar ba/ gti mug gi mun pa gtibs pa/ nga rgyal gyi brag ri gtams pa/ phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bab pa/ dug dang nad thams cad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ de'i nang du nri las byad ma nag la haṃ pa/ sngo la rid pa/ shin tu nyam thag pa gan rkyal du 'gyel ba/ mig shi mig tu blta ba/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa gcig tu gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi/ dge 'dun gyi/ khro mo'i rgyal mo gdugs dkar mo can gyi/ bden pa chen po 'di'i byin rlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la/ snga dgra lag la bdar zhing*/ phyis dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra dngos su byed pa'i gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i nya'u 'di la lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig

zhags pa can rnams kyis chings shig lcags sgrogs can rnams kyis sdoms shig dril bu can rnams kyis myos shig sarba sha trun/ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas gtsug tor gdugs dkar can// shin tu khros nas dgra bgegs dgug pa'i phyir// dregs pa'i las byed thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// lcags kyu dkar mo'i tshogs ni skar ltar 'phro// zhags pa ser mo'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs// lcags sgrog dmar mo'i tshogs ni glog ltar 'gyed// dril bu ljang mo'i tshogs ni thog ltar 'bebs// thams cad khros pa'i nga ro 'brug las che// rgyug pa'i shugs ni bar snang 'khyug las myur// gtum pa'i brjid ni gnam sa 'phar zhing ldeg /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs gar 'dug mkhyen// lcags kyus snying phug zhags pas ske nas chings// lcags sgrog gis sdoms dril bus mnyed bzhin du// las kyi rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i khar bskyon la/ gzugs byang 'di la bstim pa'i dus la bab// ces bskul/ pho nya rnams kyis byad ma mkhan po'i snying gar lcags kyus btab zhags pas rke bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams/ dril bu dang mtshon cha sna tshogs pas rgyab nas mnye zhing rnga mong la bskyon/ de las kyi rlung dmar gyis bdas pas bye'u khras ded pa bzhin mdun gyi nya'u thim par bsam/ khugs rtags ma thon gyi bar du bya/ khugs rtags bstan nas/ bya rog dang 'ug pa'i dang sgros sam zor mdas 'byed cing*/ oṃ kā ka mu kha mthu mo che// mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu// rtog med zas su sha la dga'// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ hūm̐ u lu mu kha mthu mo che// ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i bgo /nyin mtshan med par 'jig rten rgyu// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// lha dang dgra ru phrol la shog /lus dang srung mar phrol la shog /khyo dang chung mar phrol la shog /pha dang bu ru phrol la shog /gnyen dang nye bar phrol la shog

/pho bo nu bor phrol lo shog /lha srungs gnam gyi mtha' la bdos// dgra bo rdul du rlag par gyis// thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags kyi mthar// dgra bo pho lha dang phye/ mo lha dang phye/ yul lha dang phye/ dgra lha dang phye/ srog lha dang phye/ zhes phur bu bsgril zhing*/ 'phrin las chen po'i dus la bab// rdo rje phur bu kī lā ya// stod ni khro bo 'bar ba'i zhal// 'chang bzung rdo rje glog stong 'khyug /chu srin kha nas 'brug stong ldir// sku smad zur gsum dbal ldan pa// dgra bgegs steng du kī lā ya// skad cig nyid la srog dang phrol// zhes gzir bas/ tshe rten a bdag nyid kyi tshe'i gsos su blangs/ srog rten nri hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa 'og min lha'i zhing du gshegs/ de nas/ lha'i gdon nam/ klu'i gdon nam/ nas nam gru'i gdon dang*/ de dag thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do phur bus gdab bo// gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang*/ nas/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba de dag thams cad dang gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo nas gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas ba'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab po'i bar brjod/ oṃ a si tā nas lārka zhes nas/ wa sinī ye'i bar gyis thams cad 'joms pa'i rig sngags bzlas/ phur bu bskor zhig nya 'ur btab/ slar las phur sor brgyad pa re gnas so sor gdab cing 'di brjod/ hūm̐/ dgra bgegs 'byung po las ngan 'di// dang por zhe sdang pha las brgyud// bar du 'dod chags mngal sgo 'grims// tha mar nyon mongs lnga yi gzugs// phung po brtsad nas gcad pa'i phyir// srid pa'i chags sa lte ba yin// lte ba'i dkyil du kī lā ya// rnam shes gnas sa snying yin pas// snying gi dkyil du kī lā ya// lta bar byed pa mig yin pas/ mig gi= nyan par byed pa rna ba yin/ rna ba'i= snom par byed pa sna yin pas/

sna yi= myong bar byed pa lce yin pas/ lce yi= bskyod par byed pa yan lag yin// yan lag bzhi la kī lā ya// thun rnams rdeg cing*/ yungs kar rgyal po shi rā raṃ// khro rgyal yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /ma mo yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ gdug pa'i dug rlangs rlung ltar 'tshub// dug lnga yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ dpag med drag po mda' yi thun// bdud 'joms yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ stobs chen rtsal 'chang rdo yi thun// phra men yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐ rdo rje 'khor lo dbyug tho sogs// mtshon cha yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ral gri yis// log rtog 'khor ba rgyun bcad do// dum bur byas nas gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdung*/ hūm̐/ bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di// mtshon cha rnon pos bsgral zin gyis// khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ sha rus dmar myog gtang*/ de nas bstab pa/ hūm̐/ gdugs dkar mo yi lha tshogs rnams// phye zhig phye zhig zhal phye zhig /don dam chos nyid zhal phye zhig /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig /gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs shig /bar snang tsam gyi ljags sgril la// stong gsum tsam gyi mid pa gdongs/

khams gsum 'khor ba'i phung khams skye// dgra bgegs sha rus ma lus pa// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du dril lo a ra li// dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nam mkha' lha yi byad byed dang*// sa gzhi klu yi byad byed dang*// bar snang gnyan gyi byad byed dang*// stong gsum mi yi byad byed dang*// snang srid lha 'dre'i byad byed dang*// gling bzhi bon po mu stegs dang*// yul mi rje dang khyim mtshes kyi// 'tshe ba'i sems kyis bsams dang smra// lus kyis rtsub pa'i sbyor byed sogs// de dag gzhi rten lus sems rnams// zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi// mgul du dril lo a ra li// dbyings su bsgral lo sa ma ya// de nas phyi phung mchod rdzas su byas pa'i snying gi 'khor lo khyi thod la sogs par bcug thun rdzas kyi steng re bas gril/ tshon skud sna lngas legs par bcings nas them pa'i 'og gam/ lam rgya gram mam mchod rten 'og tu dong gru gsum pa brus// de'i nang du bden bdar dang dgug gzhug byas te bcug de'i kha g.yam pa la rdo rje rgya gram ri rab bris pas bcad/ de'i steng du me dang chu dang sas bcibs te las kyi gshin rje la gtad dmod bcol rgyas pa bya'o// mnan pa'o// mngon spyod ni/ gzhan 'dra ba la lte ba'i ming gi mthar mā ra ya btags pa bris/ mthar gdab las byas pa'i ling ro snying nang gi 'khor lo dang bcas brgya rtsa brgyad du gsil la liṅga bcos drag po'i sbyin sreg gis mtha' brtul lo// thun mong du stong bzlog zhi ba dang 'brel ba dang*/ mdos gzhan du bshad/ lhag par drag po la/ khams sa'i mi mo'i gzugs bzhi sgong zor khrag gis bkang ba dang*/ rdo zor dur khrod kyi rdo nag bh+yo bris pa/ mda' zor 'ug sgro skyer pa'i mde'u can bzhi dang*/ rwa dug la sogs pa zor gyi rjes su ma blugs pa'i snod bzhi/

dmar gtor cha bzhi 'dzom na bcu bcu'am/ brgyad dam ma 'dzom na bzhi bzhi/ sngags mkhan de mtshungs sam rang gcig pu/ lus la dug dang khrag gis byugs/ ye shes dang las dkyil bsgrub/ de nas khams sa'i mi mo// bdud gshin rje/ gnod sbyin klu'i bu mo/ zor bzhi rnams gyer bzhin du gsal btab ste thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags la bh+yo btags pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bskul btang ba ni/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa yi// gtsug tor dbus na sprul pa'i sku// gdon bzlog gzhan gyis mi thub ma// chos byed rnams kyi mgon byed cing*// sdig la dga' ba 'dul mdzad ma/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// dgra bgegs ma lus tshar chod cig /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba nas// legs ldan nag po mched gsum ni// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bh+yo// shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung*// dri za'i dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// gshin rje'i dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu yi dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// phyogs bcu skyong ba'i mgon po ni// rang sde'i dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// lha 'dre dregs pa gdug pa can// gnod pa skyel cing mi srog 'phrog /phyogs mtshams steng 'og gnas pa'i gdon// thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// mi mo bzhi/

mthing nag 'bar ba'i shar phyogs nas// bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu ma// mgo gcig phugs kyi nor la rgyug /mgo gcig bang mgo lha la rgyug /mgo gcig steng gi khyo la rgyug /mgo gcig mchan gyi bu la rgyug /mgo gcig chung ma dag la rgyug /mgo gcig ra ba'i phugs la rgyug /mgo gcig thang gi zhing la rgyug /mgo gcig phugs kyi sris la rgyug /gshin rje khros pa'i mthu mo che// na bza' dkar nag spel ma la// lag na dung gi spu gri thogs// dgra bo'i shan pa bdud kyi ma// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bh+yo// hūm̐// mthing nag 'bar ba'i lho phyogs na// bdud mo gshin rje lag ring ma// rāk+ṣa khros pa snying sbyin ma// lag pa lnga brgyas bar snang yug /g.yas pa lnga brgyas dgra bo 'dzin// g.yon pa lnga brgyas dgra bo gsod// drongs shig dgra bo'i mgul nas drongs// hūm̐/ mthing nag 'bar ba'i nub phyogs na// bdud mo gshin rje phung khrol ma// mi yi pags pa gos su gyon// sgyu ma'i 'phreng ba thod du bcings// mgo las sprul pa'i gshin rje 'gyed// g.yas pa lcags kyi ser ba thogs// bstan pa bsnub pa'i mgo lus 'brel// hūm̐/ mthing nag 'bar ba'i byang phyogs nas// bdud mo gshin rje lag brgya ma// g.yas pa lnga bcu zor ba thogs// dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo lus 'brel// g.yon pa lnga bcu zhags pa thogs// dam nyams dgra bo'i rke la 'debs// khyod ni klu yi lcam mo ste// dam nyams dgra bo rdul du rlog/

de ltar bskul nas sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs sgo ma rtag gdong dkar// byams pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis// shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phye// 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /nga yis ma nyes ma lan no// gtor ma'i zor lam dgra steng phye// lho phyogs sgo ma phag gdong ser// snying rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis// lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phye// 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /nga yis ma nyes ma lan no// gtor ma'i zor lam dgra steng phye// nub phyogs sgo ma seng gdong dmar// dga' ba lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis// nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phye// 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /nga yis ma nyes ma lan no// gtor ma'i zor lam dgra steng phye// byang phyogs sgo ma spyang gdong ljang*// btang snyoms dril bu'i phyag rgya yis// byang phyogs lcags sgo nag po phye// 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /nga yis ma nyes ma lan no// gtor ma'i zor lam dgra steng phye// lam bstan pa ni/ hūm̐/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan// gtor ma'i lam bstan shar du bstan// shar du rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za pho mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// sku gzur de ni spyan byol zhig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po bskyil li li// thun zor ser phran nyi li li// mda' zor skar ltar breng se breng*// thor zor rbab ltar hril li li// chu zor sha ra thibs se thibs// rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad// gtor ma'i lam bstan lho ru bstan// lho ru rgyal po 'phags skyes po// gshin rje pho mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// sku gzur/ gtor ma'i lam bstan nub tu bstan// nub tu rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu dbang mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// sku gzur/ gtor ma'i lam bstan byang du bstan/ byang du rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// sku gzur de ni spyan byol zhig

/gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po bskyil li li// thun zor ser phran nyi li li// mda' zor skar ltar breng se breng*// thor zor rbab ltar hril li li// chu zor sha ra thibs se thibs// rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad// bzlog byang ni/ hūm̐/ bzlog bsgyur bsgyur ba'i mthu mo che// dgra dpung 'joms pa'i rtsal mo che// nad kha gcod pa'i dbang mo che// lha srin khol ba'i gshed mo che/ khyod kyi mthu stobs gzi byin gyis// phas kyi byad kha thams cad bzlog /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams sgyur// lha 'dre'i za kha dgra la gtong*// hūm̐/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che// lha yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// gtum po chen mo stobs chen mo// klu yi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che// lha min gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo// rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba gos dkar mo// nam mkha' lding gi gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can// dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng zhes grags// mi'am ci'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje mtshan// lto 'phye chen po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// gzhan gyis mi thub 'phreng ba can// gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rdo rje mkhar rnams 'joms pa mo// srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma// yi dwags gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can// sha za'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo// 'byung po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan ma// grul bum gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma// srul po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// lag na rdo rje rigs gser 'phreng*// lus srul gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma// skem byed gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags// rjed byed gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rnam par 'gying ma'i rdo rje can// smyo byed gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma// grib gnon gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang*// gnon po'i gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol// pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*// nam gru gdon tshogs bzlog tu gsol//

zor gzhan sngar gyi thun rdzas bzhin la/ sgong zor/ bdun brgyud gcod pa'i sgong zor 'di// drag sngags yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku// zhes 'phang*/ gtor ma rnams brdeg gdugs dkar mo can 'khor dang bcas pas pha rol gyi yul khams su dmag bteg dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa brlag par byas par bsam mo// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas snod gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i nang du zan dang*/ khu ba dang*/ chan dang*/ 'bru'i tshogs dang*/ shing thog dang*/ rin po che'i tshogs dang*/ sman dang ldan par byas te/ de nas bdag nyid lha'i sbyor bas a kā ros sbyangs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel la/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams te/ de'i phyogs rnams su hrīḥlas pad+ma'i tshogs bskyod pa la phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa chos kyi srung ma dang*/ khyad par du tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*// legs ldan la sogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spyan drang bar bya'o// kha 'bar ma bsngo'o// yang*/ 'byung po'i gtor ma gnyis pa lha'i gdon la sogs pa dang*/ zas su mdangs za ba sogs kun la sbyin par bya'o// de yang lce rdo rjer bsam zhing sbu gus bdud rtsi thams cad ngoms shing tshim par bya ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char bzhin 'byung bar bsam mo// de nas tha mar bzod par gsol te/ gsol ba btab nas yi ge brgya pa brjod do// thams cad gshegs so// 'di ltar gdugs dkar mo can gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyi cho ga 'di/ chos sde chen po dpal 'khor bde chen gyi rin sdings pa'i slob dpon sngags 'chang chen po tshe dbang dpal 'byor dang*/ khyad par dge slong 'od zer bas bskul ba'i ngor/ pad+ma dkar pos tsan dra go mi'i gzhung bzhin du bskul ba po'i 'dod pa ltar nyang stod ri nang nu ma chos lung gi dgon pa rje mi la'i sgrub phug tu grags par sbyar ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig// /
